doc: The first-match tutorial (scripts/match/tutorial.gd). steps: [id, headline, sub line, pill]. %K the step's key, %J jump, %G glide, %E the E key, %T the Boki key, %s the Boki's name, %A an ability's name. labels: the marker's caption per step.
steps: Steer with %K to land on the meadow
Follow your Boki and the glowing beam
Your Boki runs ahead and waits for you
Press %K to dash across the gap
A dash is a quick burst. Use it to cross gaps and dodge
Jump (%J), then press %K in the air to dash
An air dash goes much further than a jump. Leave from the glowing pad
Jump, then dash in the air (%K)
Jump, then hold %G in the air to glide
Gliding carries you over the void. Follow the wind stream to the beam
Jump and glide to the beam (%G)
Hold %K to crouch and see much further. Monsters also notice you less.
Climb the lookout and crouch at the top. You move slower while crouched
Climb up and hold %K to crouch
Walk up to the glowing item on the ground
Press %K to pick up the item
Press %K to use %A on the group
Your hunter ability. It needs a moment to recharge
Right click (%K): tap it, then hold it
%A. A quick tap does one thing, holding it does another
It fights on its own. Press %K again to call it back
While it's out, it casts its ability on its own
Walk to the chest and hold %K to open it
You spotted this one from the lookout
Clear the monsters with everything you learned
Shoot, press %E, right click, and send %s with %T
Follow the marker to the outpost
Its uplink calls you a way home
Hold %K at the uplink mast to start it
Starting it draws monsters to the outpost
Hold the outpost while the uplink charges
The lift is open. Step into the light
